# ClimbingWallPlugin 🧗‍♀️

A Minecraft Paper plugin for version 1.21+ that adds realistic climbing wall mechanics to your server!

## ✨ Features

### 🎨 Complete GUI System
- **📊 Interactive Menus**: Full graphical interface for all features
- **🏗️ Wall Creation Menu**: Build walls in 4 different sizes (Small/Medium/Large/Massive)
- **📈 Statistics Dashboard**: View all your climbing data with beautiful displays
- **🏆 Achievements Tracker**: 14 achievements with visual progress
- **📋 Leaderboards**: Compete in 3 categories (Distance/Speed/Height)
- **⚡ Power-Ups Manager**: Monitor 5 different power-ups
- **📖 Interactive Guide**: Learn techniques through visual tutorials
- **🖱️ Click-Based Navigation**: No commands needed, just click!

### Core Mechanics
- **Easy Climbing System**: Simply walk into a climbing wall block to start climbing
- **Realistic Physics**: Smooth climbing movement with configurable speed
- **Intuitive Controls**: SPACE to climb up, WASD for horizontal movement
- **Admin Controls**: Create and remove climbing walls with simple commands

### Advanced Mechanics v2.0
- **⚡ Stamina System**: 100 stamina points that drain while climbing and regenerate when resting
- **🚀 Wall Jumping**: Press SHIFT while climbing to jump off the wall in the opposite direction
- **📍 Auto Checkpoints**: Automatically saves your position every 5 blocks climbed
- **🎨 Particle Effects**: Beautiful visual effects while climbing and jumping
- **🔊 Sound Effects**: Immersive audio feedback for all climbing actions
- **💪 Stamina Bar**: Real-time stamina display shows your remaining energy
- **💨 Momentum System**: Build momentum as you climb for enhanced movement
- **🔥 Combo System**: Chain actions together for speed bonuses (up to 2x speed!)
- **📐 Corner Climbing**: Special mechanics for climbing wall corners
- **🏆 Achievements**: 14 unlockable achievements with rewards
- **📊 Statistics**: Track climbs, distance, height, speed, and more
- **📋 Leaderboards**: Compete with other players in multiple categories
- **⚡ Power-Ups**: 5 special abilities including Speed Boost, Double Jump, and more
- **🏁 Race System**: Create and join competitive climbing races

## 🎮 How to Play

### For Players
1. Find a climbing wall block (created by admins)
2. **Walk into the wall** to start climbing
3. **SPACE** - Climb up (uses stamina)
4. **WASD** - Move horizontally on the wall
5. **SHIFT** - Jump off the wall (costs 20 stamina)
6. Walk away from the wall to stop climbing

### For Admins
1. Use `/cw gui` for graphical interface
2. OR use traditional commands:
   - Look at any solid block
   - Run `/cw create` to make it a climbing wall
   - To remove: look at a climbing wall and run `/cw remove`
3. Use `/cw info` to see plugin statistics

## Requirements 🔧
- **Minecraft Version**: 1.21+
- **Server Software**: Paper, Purpur, or other Paper-based servers
- **Java Version**: Java 17 or higher
